description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named NoteListAdapter used to display a list of notes in a UI. It manages ViewHolder creation, binding data, and handling click events on note items.

classes.name: NoteListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying Note objects in a RecyclerView, handling item clicks and updating the note list.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: Inner ViewHolder class that holds references to note item views and binds note data.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new list of notes and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the note item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds note data to the ViewHolder based on position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder views.
